sentences.en: The Drama Festival was last week, and everyone enjoyed the performances.
sentences.zh: 戏剧节上周举行，大家都很喜欢那些演出。

sentences.en: Our school is hosting a Drama Festival this weekend with plays from different countries.
sentences.zh: 我们学校这周末要举办一个戏剧节，会有不同国家的剧目表演。

sentences.en: She's been rehearsing all month for the big role in the Drama Festival play.
sentences.zh: 她这个月一直在彩排，为的是在戏剧节的剧中扮演一个重要角色。
